messages:
devon: Heads-up — we rolled firewall hardening for CVE-2026-04 into eu-prod at 2026-03-18T09:12Z. After the push, keystore egress to keystore-priv (10.4.5.23:443) started getting RSTs and node joins are failing. Warm pool not filling.
ops-bot: Alert: keystore-decrypt-errors spiked in eu-west-1 — 47 GPU nodes failing to join. Creating incident INC-2026-045.
maria: Confirmed — the new rule removed the previous SNI exception. Egress now blocks the HSM endpoint. Rule is too restrictive for keystore traffic.
sara: Rolling back fully reopens the CVE vector. We need a scoped exception to restore capacity without undoing hardening. Thoughts?
devon: Proposal: add a temporary explicit allow for the keystore-priv subnet (10.4.5.0/24) in the EU firewall chain, keep the rest of the hardening. Deploy to prod with a 3-node staging canary first. Also whitelist NAT healthcheck IPs.
oncall: Do it. Coordinate with sec for audit trail. Post approval in the change.
maria: Applying allow rule now.

```
# terraform snippet (apply targeted allow)
terraform apply -target=module.firewall_rule.allow_keystore_eu -auto-approve
# sanity check
aws ec2 describe-network-acls --filters "Name=tag:env,Values=eu" | jq .
```

devon: Keystore decrypt logs returning OK. `keystore-decrypt: OK` — join backlog decreasing.
maria: `kubectl get nodes --selector=region=eu-west -o wide | grep NotReady` went 47 -> 18 -> 8 over 12m after rule.
devon: Warm pool catching up. Autoscaler consumed backlog. For stragglers we ran a targeted rejoin: `rgwctl rejoin --region eu-west --node-ids $(cat stuck_nodes.txt)`
sara: Cost note: extra retries, spot churn, and reboots estimated ~USD 6,200 for the 4h remediation window. Allocated to infra incident code. I'll file in billing.
maria: Logged change CHG-2026-987; attaching terraform plan output and flow logs to the change. Runbook stub created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-egress-firewall
oncall: Action items: 1) devon — document the temporary allow and exact ACL lines, 2) sara — add a staging integration test for keystore reachability in CI, 3) maria — draft postmortem and include audit artifacts. Tagging @olivia (sec) for compliance signoff.
olivia (sec): We need: who approved the exception, justification, timeline, and full flow log dump. Keep the exception TTL short and schedule a re-review.
devon: Added approver metadata and timestamps to CHG-2026-987. Uploaded flow logs + terraform plan diff.
maria: Final status: last rejoin finished, warm pool healthy, cluster stable at 09:45 UTC. Keeping tightened alerting on keystore-decrypt. Starting postmortem doc now and will include cost estimate and remediation timeline.
oncall: Nice triage. Paste final runbook checklist here when ready. :thumbsup:
maria: Runbook posted — contains rollback steps, commands to verify keystore decrypt, and links to audit artifacts. Scheduling sec follow-up to decommission temporary allow within 48h unless approved longer. Closing incident INC-2026-045.
